name: [☢️] 99 Nights in the Shelter
desc:
Gather supplies, manage your thirst/hunger, and fight off intruders. But beware: something isn’t right down here. 

Every sound echoes, every shadow hides a secret, and trust is a luxury you can’t afford.

🔑 Explore a collapsing world
⚡ Manage your resources carefully
👁️ Survive both reality… and what lies beyond

How long can you last before the world consumes you?
